dedupe_keys.name: university of malaga solar energetic particle model

description: UMASEP combines event predictors for different energetic-particle bands. It distinguishes magnetic-connection conditions and uses relationships between solar electromagnetic observations and particle flux to issue warnings or all-clear forecasts. The resource is documented by University of Malaga. The documented physical domain is Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Continuous/RT Run (ISWA data tree), Continuous/RT Run (SEP Scoreboard Intensity), Continuous/RT Run (ISWA layout). A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The NAIRAS record mentions UMASEP as an unused prospective input, which is not coverage of this model family. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
